title: PlayStation Plus October 2026 Games Include F1 25 and Hunt: Showdown 1896
summary: Sony has revealed the PlayStation Plus monthly games for October 2026, featuring F1 25, Hunt: Showdown 1896 and Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2. The lineup combines official Formula 1 racing, tense extraction-shooter encounters and cooperative battles against giant enemies. Eligible subscribers can claim the games during the monthly offer period, which runs from October 6 to November 2, 2026, subject to regional availability and the terms of the PlayStation Store.
content:
Sony has announced the PlayStation Plus monthly games for October 2026, giving subscribers access to three different gaming experiences. This month's selection includes F1 25, Hunt: Showdown 1896 and Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2. Each game represents a different genre, ranging from competitive motorsport to atmospheric extraction combat and colorful cooperative action.

The October lineup offers variety for players with different interests. Racing fans can compete on Formula 1 circuits in F1 25, players who enjoy high-risk multiplayer encounters can enter the world of Hunt: Showdown 1896, and those looking for cooperative action can fight enormous enemies in Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2.

According to the supplied PlayStation Blog announcement, the monthly games became available on October 6, 2026, and can be claimed through November 2, 2026. As with other PlayStation Plus monthly selections, subscribers should check their regional PlayStation Store to confirm eligibility, availability and the exact offer details.

## PlayStation Plus October 2026 Lineup

The October selection brings together three games with substantially different approaches to gameplay. Rather than concentrating on one genre, the lineup gives eligible subscribers an opportunity to explore racing, survival-focused multiplayer combat and cooperative shooting.

F1 25 is the choice for players interested in Formula 1 motorsport. It focuses on racing, team management elements, career progression and competition on officially represented circuits. The game appeals to players who enjoy improving lap times, learning braking points and finding a balance between speed and consistency.

Hunt: Showdown 1896 offers a very different experience. It combines monster hunting, exploration and encounters with rival hunters in a dangerous extraction-shooter environment. Players must weigh the potential rewards of continuing a mission against the risk of losing the progress they have made during a run.

Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 takes a more colorful approach to action. Its voxel-inspired presentation contrasts with its large-scale battles against giant enemies. Cooperative play is a central part of the experience, giving players a reason to coordinate their attacks and work together against overwhelming threats.

The three games provide different reasons to use a PlayStation Plus membership this month. Players can choose a familiar competitive sport, a tense multiplayer challenge or a cooperative action game depending on their preferred style.

## F1 25: Official Formula 1 Racing

F1 25 is the racing-focused entry in the October 2026 PlayStation Plus lineup. Based on the Formula 1 championship, the game is designed around high-speed circuit racing, car control, race strategy and competition. It provides an option for both players who enjoy motorsport simulations and fans who want to experience the atmosphere of a Formula 1 weekend from home.

One of the main attractions of an F1 game is the challenge of learning each circuit. Players need to understand where to brake, how to approach corners and when to accelerate without compromising control. Even a small mistake can affect lap time, particularly when racing against opponents who maintain a consistent pace.

Race strategy can be just as important as outright speed. Tire condition, pit-stop decisions, weather and the timing of important race events can influence the result, depending on the selected mode and race settings. Players who concentrate only on driving quickly may overlook decisions that help maintain performance throughout a longer race.

Career progression offers another reason to keep playing. Players who enjoy long-term development can work through a racing season, improve their performance and pursue new objectives. The broader Formula 1 setting also provides a familiar framework for fans who follow the real championship.

Online competition can offer an additional challenge for players who want to test their skills against other people. Racing against human opponents can be less predictable than racing against computer-controlled drivers, because other players may use different strategies and make different decisions under pressure.

Newcomers should consider starting with settings that make the driving experience comfortable before increasing the difficulty. Learning braking points, understanding how the car responds and becoming familiar with circuit layouts can make races more enjoyable. More experienced players may prefer to adjust assists and difficulty settings to create a greater challenge.

For PlayStation Plus subscribers who enjoy racing games, F1 25 is one of the main attractions of October's selection. Its combination of circuit racing, progression and competition makes it a different proposition from the other two games included in the monthly lineup.

## Hunt: Showdown 1896: High-Risk Extraction Combat

Hunt: Showdown 1896 is the October lineup's extraction-shooter option. Its gameplay combines hunting dangerous targets with surviving encounters against other players. The setting emphasizes tension, sound awareness and careful decision-making, creating a different atmosphere from a conventional fast-paced arena shooter.

Players enter dangerous environments to pursue objectives and gather rewards. However, completing an objective is only part of the challenge. Players must also consider whether they can safely leave the area and secure the rewards they have earned during the mission.

This creates a constant balance between risk and reward. Continuing to explore may provide opportunities to gain additional resources or complete another objective, but it can also expose a team to more enemies. Leaving earlier may be the safer decision, while staying longer may offer a greater potential payoff.

The presence of rival hunters adds another layer of uncertainty. Other players may be pursuing the same targets, waiting near important locations or attempting to intercept teams that are preparing to leave. As a result, players must consider both the game's hostile environment and the possibility of human opponents.

Sound awareness is an important skill in this type of experience. Movement, combat and other audible activity can provide information about nearby threats. Players who rush through every area without considering the noise they make may reveal their position or miss clues that could help them avoid an unfavorable encounter.

Team coordination can also make a difference. Players who communicate can share information about enemy positions, decide when to engage and plan how to approach an extraction. Entering a fight without a clear idea of the team's objective can make it harder to respond when the situation changes.

Hunt: Showdown 1896 is therefore suited to players who enjoy suspense, tactical decisions and multiplayer encounters where survival matters. It is less about winning every immediate firefight and more about making decisions that allow players to complete their objectives and leave with their progress intact.

For subscribers who have not tried an extraction shooter before, the game offers an opportunity to explore a genre in which patience and awareness can be as important as aiming skill. New players should take time to understand the objectives, equipment and extraction process before committing to riskier encounters.

## Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2: Cooperative Battles

Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 completes the October selection with a cooperative action experience built around battles against giant enemies. Its voxel-inspired visual style gives the game a colorful appearance, while its large-scale encounters focus on combat, teamwork and surviving waves of threats.

The game's presentation differs considerably from the darker atmosphere of Hunt: Showdown 1896. Instead of emphasizing stealth and extraction, Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 places players in exaggerated action scenarios where enemies can dominate the battlefield and coordinated attacks become important.

Cooperative play is a major part of its appeal. Players can work together to handle groups of enemies, support their teammates and respond to changing situations. When the battlefield becomes crowded, coordinating movement and choosing suitable targets can make encounters easier to manage.

The voxel-inspired art direction is another distinguishing feature. Its block-based appearance gives characters and environments a stylized identity that separates the game from more realistic third-person and first-person shooters. The colorful presentation also contrasts with the scale of the battles, creating an intentionally exaggerated action experience.

Players who enjoy collecting equipment, experimenting with different approaches and working through increasingly demanding encounters may find the game appealing. As with other cooperative action games, learning how different abilities and equipment fit together can help a team become more effective.

For subscribers who prefer playing with friends, Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 provides an alternative to competitive racing and high-risk extraction gameplay. Its focus on teamwork gives players a reason to coordinate their actions rather than treating every encounter as an individual contest.

The game also broadens the appeal of the monthly selection. Someone who is not interested in Formula 1 racing or tense extraction encounters may still find value in a colorful cooperative shooter with giant enemies and large battles.

## When Can You Claim the October 2026 Games?

According to the supplied PlayStation Blog announcement, the October 2026 monthly games became available on October 6 and remain claimable until November 2, 2026. Eligible subscribers should check their local PlayStation Store for the exact availability window and any regional differences.

Players should remember that a monthly game offer has a defined claim period. Waiting until the final day can create unnecessary problems if a player forgets to add the games to their library or encounters an issue accessing the store. Checking the lineup early is a straightforward way to avoid missing the offer.

The process begins by signing in with the PlayStation Network account associated with the subscription. Players can then open the PlayStation Store, locate the monthly games section and follow the available claim instructions. The exact interface may differ between a PS5 console, a PS4 console and the web version of the store.

Before claiming a game, subscribers should verify that the account has an eligible PlayStation Plus membership. They should also make sure they are viewing the correct regional store, since game availability and promotional terms can vary by region.

It is useful to distinguish claiming a game from simply opening its store page. Players should follow the store's instructions to add the title to their library and confirm that the transaction or claim has completed successfully.

Subscribers who already own one of the selected games may still want to review the other titles. The monthly lineup includes three different genres, so a player who has already tried F1 25 may find a new experience in Hunt: Showdown 1896 or Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2.

## What PlayStation Plus Members Should Know

PlayStation Plus provides access to different benefits depending on the membership tier and the current offer. Monthly games are a familiar part of the service, but players should not assume that every benefit works in exactly the same way across all subscription levels or regions.

The monthly games included in a promotion are generally associated with an eligible subscription and must be claimed during the offer period. Players should consult the current PlayStation Plus terms for information about access requirements, account eligibility and what happens if a membership expires.

Claiming a monthly game is also different from purchasing it outright. Players should review the store information and membership conditions so they understand how access is provided. If a title is available through another promotion or a separate purchase, its terms may differ from the monthly PlayStation Plus offer.

Regional differences are another important consideration. Release times, storefront listings and promotional details can vary, meaning that the exact information displayed in one country may not match another. The local PlayStation Store is the most relevant source for an individual account.

Players should also be aware that the monthly games lineup changes over time. A title that is included in October's selection may no longer be claimable through that offer after the stated deadline. Future availability, discounts and inclusion in other subscription benefits should not be assumed without an official announcement.

## Which October Game Should You Play First?

The best starting point depends on what a player wants from a game. F1 25 is the natural choice for those who enjoy motorsport, learning circuits and improving lap times. Players who appreciate high-pressure multiplayer encounters may prefer Hunt: Showdown 1896, while those who want cooperative action against large numbers of enemies may be drawn to Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2.

Players who enjoy improving a skill over time may gravitate toward F1 25. Learning a circuit and becoming more consistent can provide a clear sense of progress. Racing fans can also explore different driving settings and approaches to find a comfortable level of challenge.

Hunt: Showdown 1896 is better suited to people who enjoy uncertainty and tactical decision-making. The possibility of losing progress during a dangerous mission makes each decision more meaningful. Players who prefer to plan their movements and carefully assess threats may appreciate this structure.

Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 may be the best choice for a more cooperative session. Its emphasis on battling giant enemies gives players a shared objective, and its stylized presentation creates a different atmosphere from the other titles in the lineup.

There is no single correct choice for every subscriber. The advantage of a three-game selection is that players can try different genres and decide which experience suits their interests. Someone who normally plays racing games may discover an interest in cooperative action, while a shooter fan may enjoy the challenge of learning Formula 1 circuits.

## Why the October 2026 Selection Stands Out

The October lineup is notable for the contrast between its three featured games. F1 25 focuses on motorsport and precision, Hunt: Showdown 1896 emphasizes tension and survival, and Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 delivers colorful cooperative combat. Each title appeals to a different set of preferences, giving subscribers a varied selection rather than three games that offer nearly identical experiences.

Genre variety can be useful for players who want to discover games they might not normally purchase. A monthly selection provides a reason to look beyond familiar genres and experiment with different styles of play. Players who are unsure whether they enjoy extraction shooters or cooperative action can use the lineup as an opportunity to explore those experiences, provided they meet the offer's eligibility requirements.

The selection also offers different ways to play. F1 25 can appeal to people who enjoy solo progression as well as competitive racing, while Hunt: Showdown 1896 places considerable emphasis on multiplayer encounters. Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 is particularly relevant to players looking for cooperative battles.

Ultimately, the value of the lineup depends on individual taste. A subscriber who already owns one title may find the other two more interesting, while a player who enjoys all three genres may have several reasons to participate. Checking the official store pages can help players understand each game's current features and requirements before starting.

## Final Thoughts

PlayStation Plus October 2026 brings together three games with very different strengths. F1 25 provides Formula 1 racing and a focus on precision, Hunt: Showdown 1896 offers tense extraction combat in a dangerous world, and Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 delivers colorful cooperative battles against giant enemies.

According to the supplied announcement, the games became available on October 6 and can be claimed until November 2, 2026. Eligible members should confirm the offer in their regional PlayStation Store and claim the games before the monthly window closes.

For racing fans, F1 25 is the main attraction. For players who enjoy high-risk multiplayer decisions, Hunt: Showdown 1896 provides a very different challenge. For those who prefer cooperative action and exaggerated battles, Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 rounds out the selection.

The October lineup gives PlayStation Plus members an opportunity to explore three distinct gaming experiences within one monthly offer. Players should check their subscription eligibility, review the local store information and make sure the games have been successfully added to their library before the deadline.
